title: 第17章 妇人胡宜第18章 封地青城
slug: 重生后长公主只想种田

大厅一时间挺乱的，沈青鱼往转着轮椅过来的云珏腿上一坐，抬手打了个响指。
几个暗卫出现，很快就将周家人压制住。
“丢出去。”沈青鱼道。
周家人怎么也想不到会有被长公主府扔出去的一天，明明从前沈青鱼爱惨了周荣，不管周荣说什么都听，最怕周荣生气。
“你究竟做了什么？”忠勇侯皱眉看向儿子。
周荣哪里知道，毕竟他做的事情多了去了。可从前的沈青鱼不这样的，不管他做了什么，都一如既往的对他好。
“这跟我孙儿有什么关系，分明是这个贱人开脉了，就觉得了不起了，想要以此拿捏我们。”周老夫人说道。
“十八岁才开脉，就算她成功入门武道，也肯定是个废物。”
忠勇侯皱起眉头：“娘，只怕她真有异心，真想要和离，修行这条路要花费的代价太大，若真和离了，那长公主府的资源就与荣儿无关了。”
周老夫人震惊：“这怎么可以！”
不知想到什么，周老夫人凑近忠勇侯耳边低语。
忠勇侯皱眉，眼中闪过一抹厌烦，但还是点了点头。
次日一大早，沈青鱼从睡梦中醒来，感觉全身前所未有的舒适。
这强度，身体好像习惯了。
就是某些人瞧着，似乎有点虚。
“不知集上有没有卖猪妖腰子，回头让人给你买几只补补。”沈青鱼说完不等云珏回应，就推门走了出去。
阳光明媚，天气似乎不错。
只是这天空看着看着，似乎有哪里不对，正当她想要仔细去看时，一道刺耳的声音在院子里响起。
“长公主殿下，皇后娘娘懿旨，请您进宫一趟。”传话的太监是玉皇后宫里的，名字好像叫起子。

他看着瘦瘦小小的，武道修为却不低。
“长公主殿下？”起子又喊了声。
沈青鱼回过神来，道：“不去。”
起子闻言不急也不恼，微笑着说道：“长公主殿下，忤逆娘娘可不是什么好事，想想你那残废面首。”
沈青鱼神色冷淡：“你在威胁本宫？”
起子忙道：“奴才可不敢。”
奴才不敢，可主子敢啊。
一个才刚刚开脉，只能依附别人而活的废物，想要其屈服，有太多的法子了。
沈青鱼看懂了，明摆着自己若是不听话的话，就要拿云珏开刀。
从前也就罢了，如今云珏可是她的炉鼎。若真让人给弄死了，她上哪再找这么一个让她修为一日千里的宝贝。
至少在她金丹前，不能让云珏出事。
“长公主殿下，若是考虑好了，就跟奴才走吧。”起子依旧微笑，十分淡定，似乎一点也不担心沈青鱼会拒绝。
沈青鱼是懒得走这一趟的，用脚指头去想也能知道，定是忠勇侯府臭不要脸的，往玉皇后那告状了。
“行吧。”去就去，就是浪费点时间，没什么好害怕的。
一大早，宣和帝正在上朝，老王突然凑到他耳边说了几句。
他眼睛一瞪，幸亏没有喝茶。
“那丫头进宫干什么了？”

The hall was quite chaotic for a while. Shen Qingyu sat on Yun Jue's lap, who was turning his wheelchair, and raised his hand to snap his fingers.
Several secret guards appeared and quickly suppressed the Zhou family.
"Throw it out." Shen Qingyu said.
The Zhou family never expected that one day they would be thrown out of the eldest princess's mansion. It was clear that Shen Qingyu had fallen in love with Zhou Rong in the past. She would listen to whatever Zhou Rong said and was most afraid of Zhou Rong's anger.
"What exactly did you do?" Marquis Zhongyong frowned and looked at his son.
How would Zhou Rong know? After all, he has done a lot of things. But Shen Qingyu was not like this in the past. No matter what he did, she always treated him well.
"What does this have to do with my grandson? It's obvious that this bitch found out his pulse and thought it was great, and wanted to use it to tease us." Mrs. Zhou said.
"She only had her pulse opened at the age of eighteen. Even if she succeeds in martial arts, she will definitely be a loser."
Marquis Zhongyong frowned: "Mom, I'm afraid she really has different intentions and really wants to reconcile. The cost of practicing this path is too high. If we really reconcile, the resources of the eldest princess's palace will have nothing to do with Rong'er."
Mrs. Zhou was shocked: "How is this possible!"
Not knowing what she was thinking of, Madam Zhou approached Zhongyong Hou and whispered in his ear.
Marquis Zhongyong frowned, a hint of boredom flashed in his eyes, but he still nodded.
Early the next morning, Shen Qingyu woke up from his sleep and felt more comfortable than ever before.
It seems like my body is used to this intensity.
It's just that some people look at it and it seems a bit vain.
"I wonder if there are pig demon kidneys for sale at the market. I'll buy some for you later." After Shen Qingyu finished speaking, she opened the door and walked out without waiting for Yun Jue to respond.
The sun was shining and the weather seemed good.
But looking at the sky, something seemed wrong. Just when she wanted to take a closer look, a harsh sound sounded in the yard.
"Your Royal Highness, the Queen, please come to the palace." The eunuch who sent the message was from the Jade Queen's palace, and his name seemed to be Suzi.
He looked thin and small, but his martial arts skills were not low.
"Your Highness the Princess?" Kaizi called again.
Shen Qingyu came to his senses and said: "I won't go."
Qi Zi was neither anxious nor annoyed when he heard this, and said with a smile: "Your Highness, the eldest princess, it is not a good thing to be disobedient to the empress. Think about your crippled face."
Shen Qingyu looked cold: "Are you threatening me?"
Qi Zi hurriedly said: "I don't dare."
The slave doesn't dare, but the master does.
There are too many ways to make a loser who has just opened his pulse and can only rely on others to survive.
Shen Qingyu understood, and it was clear that if he was disobedient, Yun Jue would be stabbed.
That was all in the past, but now Yun Jue is her furnace. If someone really killed her, where would she find such a treasure that would make her cultivation progress rapidly?
At least in front of her golden elixir, nothing could happen to Yun Jue.
"Your Highness, Princess, if you've thought about it, let's go with this servant." Qi Zi still smiled and was very calm, as if he was not worried at all that Shen Qingyu would refuse.
Shen Qingyu was too lazy to make this trip, and he could tell by just thinking about it with his toes that it must be the shameless Prince Zhongyong who complained to the Jade Queen.
"Okay." Just go, it's just a waste of time, there's nothing to be afraid of.
Early in the morning, Emperor Xuanhe was going to court, and Lao Wang suddenly leaned into his ear and said a few words.
His eyes widened. Fortunately, he didn't drink tea.
"Then what did the girl do in the palace?"
